content: As input we are given an infobox INLINEFORM0 , which is a set of pairs INLINEFORM1 where INLINEFORM2 corresponds to field names and INLINEFORM3 is the sequence of corresponding values and INLINEFORM4 is the total number of fields in INLINEFORM5 . For example, INLINEFORM6 could be one such pair in this set. Given such an input, the task is to generate a description INLINEFORM7 containing INLINEFORM8 words. A simple solution is to treat the infobox as a sequence of fields followed by the values corresponding to the field in the order of their appearance in the infobox. For example, the infobox could be flattened to produce the following input sequence (the words in bold are field names which act as delimiters)
